description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kithkin Spellduster.
When Kithkin Spellduster dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kithkin Spellduster.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
